recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a dead man's switch heartbeat to nightly-sync now, using a service such as Healthchecks.io or Cronitor: the job pings on success, and the user gets an alert if no ping arrives by 03:10. Central logging on the Synology is put off as a later, lower-priority project.
note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert and defers Docker/Loki logging until a future multi-job need; a self-hosted Healthchecks on the Synology appears only as one alternative alongside hosted services, and none of the four labelled record lines are present.
